title: Request equipment repairs and re-order consumables from EnableNSW
summary: This page explains how to request repairs for EnableNSW equipment or re-order consumables like continence, Home Enteral Nutrition, or respiratory products.
intro: If the equipment provided to you by EnableNSW needs repairing, or you need to re-order continence, Home Enteral Nutrition or respiratory consumable products, you can do this by email or phone, as long as:
what_you_need: The equipment that needs repairing or the consumable items you want to reorder

how_to_steps.text: Email the details to enable@health.nsw.gov.au or call 1800 362 253 and select the appropriate option.

external_links.text: Forms and funding criteria by program – EnableNSW

faqs.q: How can I request repairs or re-order consumables?
faqs.a: You can request repairs or re-order consumables by emailing enable@health.nsw.gov.au or calling 1800 362 253 and selecting the appropriate option.

faqs.q: What information do I need to provide?
faqs.a: You need to provide your full name, date of birth, residential address, best contact number, and details of the equipment needing repair or the consumable items you want to reorder.
